svg.text: Dashed boxes: the positions of s3, s5 and s6, which the node query didn't return.
The browser draws a link only when it draws both its nodes, so it drops s2+ s3+.
2. It draws the graph from those lines alone
Solid nodes come from node lines; dashed ones from positions in link lines.
